newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Around 20 percent of Saudi Arabia's budget allocated for education, Crown Prince Abdullah says.
- The brother of Australian nurse murdered in Saudi Arabia still demands the death penalty against two British nurses accused of the killing.
- A Pakistani drug smuggler was beheaded in Riyadh.
- Saudi Arabia is building power projects worth 33 million riyals in Dammam in the eastern province.
